stem.text: A metal wire is stretched to breaking point and the force–extension graph is plotted.
Which graph is correctly labelled with the elastic region, the plastic region and the area representing the work done to stretch the wire until it breaks?

A.alt: Graph with axes labelled force and extension, origin 0. A curve rises and levels off. Printed labels: elastic region, plastic region and work done. A dashed vertical line runs from the curve to the horizontal axis, and the area under the curve up to that line is shaded.

B.alt: Graph with axes labelled force and extension, origin 0. A curve rises and levels off. Printed labels: plastic region, elastic region and work done. The area under the whole curve is shaded.

C.alt: Graph with axes labelled force and extension, origin 0. A curve rises and levels off. Printed labels: elastic region, plastic region and work done. A dashed vertical line runs from the curve to the horizontal axis, and the area from that line to the end of the curve is shaded.

D.alt: Graph with axes labelled force and extension, origin 0. A curve rises and levels off. Printed labels: elastic region, plastic region and work done. The area under the whole curve is shaded.
